decisions.reason: Ultrastructure of a third-ventricle colloid cyst (squamous plus mucin-containing columnar epithelium) argued as non-neuroepithelial in origin; histogenesis evidence needed to weigh the paraphyseal (neuroepithelial) hypothesis; paraphysis not named.
Epiplexus (macrophage-like) cells on turtle embryo choroid epithelium; generic choroid plexus cell biology, no link to the paraphysis region.
Single mixed colloid cyst-xanthogranuloma case with EM cell types (ciliated, nonciliated, basal); abstract draws no origin conclusion and never mentions paraphysis or origin hypotheses.
Experimental paraphysectomy in bullfrog tadpoles: weight, bone fractures and parathyroid hyperplasia 22 months later; physiological role of the amphibian paraphysis.
Aminergic/cholinergic innervation of amphibian choroid plexus; abstract never relates it to the paraphysis or the paraphyseal region.
Case report of colloid cysts in identical twins (familial occurrence, ocular signs); no histogenesis data and no paraphyseal link.

Human stage 11: defines telencephalon medium as the embryonic lamina terminalis; terminology of the telencephalic territory whose roof gives the paraphysis (ontogeny/terminology); paraphysis not itself discussed.

Circadian amines in the turtle pineal-paraphyseal complex measured as combined tissue; paraphysis not analysed separately, so only contextual physiology (function) evidence; not paraphysis-specific data.
Subfornical organ and drinking in pigeon; circumventricular organ lesion study with no comparison to the paraphysis.
Experimental removal of the paraphyseal-choroid plexus complex (paraphysectomy) in adult bullfrogs: parathyroid volume, PTH immunoreactivity; function of the paraphysis.
Comparative survey states paraphysis occurs in dogfish and osteoglossomorph teleosts and that the lungfish 'paraphysis' is a dorsal sac; explicit phylogenetic distribution and terminology.
Subcommissural organ vascular/leptomeningeal projections in snake and turtle; abstract makes no comparison with the paraphysis.
Fatal undiagnosed colloid cyst case; 'paraphyseal cyst' appears only as a synonym in the abstract, no origin analysis or histogenesis data.
Stage 12 human brain; abstract only notes telencephalon medium has enlarged, no definition or roof/velum data that locates the paraphysis.
Freeze-fracture of rat ependyma and circumventricular organs; no paraphysis link.
Reserpine/chlorpromazine effects on amines in the turtle pineal-paraphyseal complex (combined tissue, paraphysis not separated); contextual physiology (function) only.
Immunohistochemical subdivisions of lungfish telencephalon (pallium, subpallium, olfactory bulb); full abstract never addresses the roof, dorsal sac or paraphysis.
Immunoperoxidase (EMA, TPA, keratin, S-100) of 8 colloid cysts concluding endodermal origin; histogenesis data needed to weigh the paraphyseal/neuroepithelial hypothesis; paraphysis not named.
General classification of benign CNS cysts; colloid cyst gets one sentence (neuroectodermal but features suggest endodermal), no paraphysis or colloid-cyst-specific data.
Immunohistochemical panel across 14 intracranial cysts of five types with a single colloid cyst; diagnostic markers, no origin conclusion for colloid cysts.
Japanese clinical/MRI case report with cavum veli interpositi; EM-based suggestion of endodermal origin is a one-line aside, paraphysis not named.
NPY brain mapping and insulin in chicks; 'subseptal organ' naming only, no paraphysis link.
Parietal-eye masking and cloacal temperature in Varanus; title indicates a pineal-complex photoreceptor study, not the paraphysis (metadata only).
Stage 13 human brain overview; lamina terminalis and commissural plate are only named in a long feature list, nothing that locates or bears on the paraphysis.

Circadian and photoperiod effects on amines in the turtle pineal-paraphyseal complex (combined tissue, paraphysis not separated); contextual physiology (function) only.
Chick pineal cytodifferentiation (photosensory and secretory cells); pineal only, no paraphysis link.
ADH/ANGII fluid balance in birds vs mammals; subfornical organ receptors only, no paraphysis link.

SEM of supraependymal cells in chicken third ventricle (median eminence, subfornical organ); no paraphysis link.

Fourth-ventricle colloid cyst case; common neuroepithelial origin with third-ventricle cysts is a one-sentence roof-embryology speculation, no histogenesis data and no paraphysis link (could be revisited as an argument against a purely paraphyseal origin).

Immunohistochemistry of 12 colloid cysts: epithelium distinct from choroid plexus/ependyma/glia, concludes primitive neuroectodermal anomaly; abstract lists the paraphysis theory but does not test it directly.
Holoprosencephaly/cyclopia embryos with absent mediobasal telencephalon; malformation study, no data bearing on the paraphysis or its homology.
Stage 16 human brain (amygdala, cortical areas, neurohypophysis); full abstract has nothing on the telencephalic roof, velum transversum or paraphysis.

Ambient temperature effects on amines in the turtle pineal-paraphyseal complex (combined tissue, paraphysis not separated); contextual physiology (function) only.
Spinal genuine endodermal epithelial cyst with criteria vs neuroepithelial cysts; intraspinal, not about third-ventricle colloid cysts or the paraphysis.

HT7 blood-brain-barrier marker in chick circumventricular organs (subfornical organ, pineal); no paraphysis link.

Lacertilian parietal-eye ganglion cells (retrograde label, EM); pineal-complex photoreceptor organ, not the paraphysis.
Frog paraphysis cerebri vasculature (casting plus TEM): sinusoidal portal bed from choroid plexus, fenestrated endothelium, proposed role in calcium metabolism.
Treefrog paraphysis ultrastructure (microvillar border, intercellular spaces) with anterior choroid plexus and endolymphatic tubules as a CSF-regulating functional unit.
